name: Trade Depot Storage Vaults
description: The Trade Depot Storage Vaults house raw materials, refined goods, clan commissions, and artisan supplies. Stone vault chambers, reinforced storage racks, arcane-sealed crates, and lift platforms support the flow of goods between Artisan Ward, Crafting Terraces, and Market Terraces. Depot clerks, supply managers, and arcane seal technicians maintain constant oversight.
